rules.evidence: Review completed public actions, exact returned tool outputs and explicit requested task artifacts only. Never inspect model reasoning or assistant message bodies.
rules.workflow: Check workspace boundaries, provider first investigation after any required failing check, permitted edits, final native validation for edit tasks, and unchanged source for analysis tasks. Harmless metadata and provider startup instructions are separate. A source or dependency failure is retained, not silently replaced.
rules.relevance: Cite action IDs that support the actual task. Counts or a successful MCP envelope alone do not establish relevance. Candidate usable evidence requires returned source, resolved API or reference information that bears on the task; empty, irrelevant and unsupported responses do not qualify. Competitor failures remain charged and can satisfy a relevant attempted retrieval.
rules.ambiguity: Unknown workflow compliance or unknown evidence usefulness blocks a qualifying claim. Automated hashes verify identities, not the reviewer’s semantic judgment.

method: Manual review of every public command, MCP argument and relevant returned output; action start/completion times and shell-internal order reviewed. Original grades were not changed. Complete result records, supplements and task artifacts were hash checked. No raw capture or assistant message was read.

runs.notes: The required native check failed before implementation investigation. Native search and source plus tinyglobby declaration/implementation reads preceded six production source edits. A later seven-case native check passed and no edit followed it. Concurrent final diff/search commands were read only. Independent grading records only permitted source edits and generated compiler outputs. No provider is advertised in this arm.

The failed required native check preceded the first task-directed provider search. Its partial search returned relevant find-packages source among noisier matches. Compiler context resolved tinyglobby 0.2.15 and the async glob overloads, but did not provide expanded option behavior or prove compatibility. Native dependency reads supplied additional semantics. The first edited check compiled but failed workspace pattern handling because patterns were passed twice; that failure and its cost remain. After a further permitted source edit, all seven native cases passed. Independent grading confirms the six permitted files only, plus allowed generated outputs.
